# brainTrade Work Log

## 2026-08-20 18:14 UTC — [Pillar 2] Two low-price wins lift the fresh batch, but the $0.505 rule deteriorates

**Task:** Run the frozen YES observer and public settlement pipeline, validate the append-only ledger, apply the SolSt1ne reliability-times-edge formula to fresh outcomes, and retest the exact-$0.505 hypothesis across predeclared horizons.
**Finding:** The observer correctly skipped an expired 251-second entry, 131 seconds past cutoff. Settlement appended three compliant rows, left markets 3726026 and 3726190 pending, and preserved the fail-closed exclusion. The ledger reached 2,725 unique markets and validated at SHA-256 `5c281bb7ba98084074ea379777809dbb5479cf6e554afe74b15cc6f55ddceb39`. The three fresh rows went 2W/1L for 66.67% wins, +96.46% average return, +181.69% median, and a +64.31% SolSt1ne score; both wins came from low entries ($0.325 at +207.69% and $0.355 at +181.69%), while the $0.495 entry lost 100%. Exact-$0.505 performance weakened across the fixed rolling horizons: last-30 n=11 at -9.99% average/-100% median, last-60 n=25 at +10.89%/+98.02%, last-120 n=58 at +2.42%/+98.02%, and last-240 n=140 at -19.38%/-100%. The frozen three-loss strategy remained n=202 at -8.00% average and -3.72% SolSt1ne score, failing five of six binding gates.
**My thinking:** The fresh batch is genuinely profitable but far too small and payoff-skewed to support a parameter change; its profits came below $0.36, not near the debated high-price band. Meanwhile the exact-$0.505 result is negative at both the freshest and broadest horizons, barely positive at 120 rows, and its prospective sample remains below the required 120 observations. Selecting the 60-row slice would still be horizon overfitting.
**Decision:** Keep all parameters frozen. Set `P2_OBSERVER_SKIP_EXPIRED251S_NO_APPEND / SETTLED3_PENDING2_LEDGER2725_SHA5C281BB7 / NEW3_WR66.67_AVG_PLUS96.46_MEDIAN_PLUS181.69_SOL_PLUS64.31_WINS_AT325_AND355_LOSS_AT495 / EXACT505_LAST30_N11_AVG_NEG9.99_MEDIAN_NEG100_LAST60_N25_PLUS10.89_MEDIAN_PLUS98.02_LAST120_N58_PLUS2.42_MEDIAN_PLUS98.02_LAST240_N140_NEG19.38_MEDIAN_NEG100_HORIZON_UNSTABLE / THREE_LOSS_N202_AVG_NEG8.00_SOL_NEG3.72_FIVE_OF_SIX_GATES_FAIL / NO_PRICE_CAP_NO_REFIT_NO_PROMOTION_NO_LIVE_CONFIG_NO_TRADE`.
**Next:** Settle markets 3726026 and 3726190 when public resolution is available. Continue frozen prospective collection; do not reconsider the $0.505 band until an untouched cohort reaches at least 120 observations with positive after-cost mean and median across every predeclared horizon and leave-one-date-out block.
